svg.title: Numbered end-to-end request sequence
svg.desc: Numbered sequence of steps for a full request: CDN check, load balancer routing, gateway auth and rate limiting, service routing, cache check, database read or write, and asynchronous event publishing to a message queue for workers

g.text: CDN serves it if static, else forwards
Load balancer picks a healthy gateway instance
Gateway authenticates and checks rate limit
Gateway routes to the right microservice
Miss — read/write the sharded, replicated DB
Result stored in cache, returned up the chain

svg.text: async branch, doesn't block the response above

g.text: Service publishes an event to the message queue
Worker picks it up later — email, notify, analytics
